name: fast-puma
description: A pair of squishy plus and minus pads in square wells with circular knobs.
purpose: Gives quantity or polarity controls the raised-to-pressed pad feel without flattening the inspo radii.
bestFor: quantity steppers that need a tactile plus and minus pair
playful settings pads that stay on semantic tokens
avoidFor: dense toolbars where the 140px wells would crowd the row
